title: Valuing Time in Silicon: Can Large Language Models Replicate Human Value of Travel Time

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the Value of Travel Time (VOT) and income elasticity by prompting LLMs with varying income levels and educational backgrounds in a simulated stated preference survey.
Comparing the estimated Value of Travel Time (VOT) generated by LLMs when assigned male versus female personas in travel choice scenarios.
Evaluating differences in the simulated Value of Travel Time (VOT) when LLMs are prompted with different age group personas (20s vs. 50s).
